query: Using the Amazon Selling Partner orders data, could you please show me, for each order item that has a promotion, whether the buyer requested to cancel it, the cancel reason if any, the order status, the payment method used for the order, the order ID, and the order item ID? Include only rows where the order has a status.
sql:
SELECT
  order_item.buyer_requested_cancel_is_buyer_requested_cancel,
  order_item.buyer_requested_cancel_buyer_cancel_reason,
  orders.order_status,
  payment_method_detail_item.method,
  payment_method_detail_item.amazon_order_id,
  order_item_promotion_id.order_item_id
FROM orders
INNER JOIN order_item_promotion_id ON orders.amazon_order_id = order_item_promotion_id.amazon_order_id
INNER JOIN order_item ON orders.amazon_order_id = order_item.amazon_order_id
  AND order_item.order_item_id = order_item_promotion_id.order_item_id
INNER JOIN payment_method_detail_item ON orders.amazon_order_id = payment_method_detail_item.amazon_order_id
WHERE orders.order_status IS NOT NULL

query: For the Amazon Selling Partner item data, please show me the classification ID and title from the classification sales rank, the classification ID from the item summary, the sales rank and category title from the display group, and for each such combination, what percentage of those items are adult products?
sql:
SELECT
  item_classification_sales_rank.classification_id,
  item_classification_sales_rank.title,
  item_summary.classification_id,
  item_display_group_sales_rank.rank,
  item_display_group_sales_rank.title,
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN item_summary.adult_product = 't' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM item_summary
INNER JOIN item_classification_sales_rank ON item_summary.asin = item_classification_sales_rank.asin
INNER JOIN item_display_group_sales_rank ON item_summary.asin = item_display_group_sales_rank.asin
GROUP BY
  item_classification_sales_rank.classification_id,
  item_classification_sales_rank.title,
  item_summary.classification_id,
  item_display_group_sales_rank.rank,
  item_display_group_sales_rank.title

query: From the Amazon Selling Partner order items data, could you please show me the order status, order ID, whether the buyer requested to cancel the item, the item price, the brand, and the item name for order lines that belong to shipped orders, but exclude any rows that would also appear if we only looked at canceled orders? In other words, show me those fields for order items on shipped orders only.
sql:
SELECT
  orders.order_status,
  orders.amazon_order_id,
  order_item.buyer_requested_cancel_is_buyer_requested_cancel,
  order_item.item_price_amount,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.brand,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_name
FROM order_item
INNER JOIN orders ON order_item.amazon_order_id = orders.amazon_order_id
INNER JOIN int_amazon_selling_partner__item ON order_item.asin = int_amazon_selling_partner__item.asin
WHERE orders.order_status = 'Shipped'
EXCEPT
SELECT
  orders.order_status,
  orders.amazon_order_id,
  order_item.buyer_requested_cancel_is_buyer_requested_cancel,
  order_item.item_price_amount,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.brand,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_name
FROM order_item
INNER JOIN orders ON order_item.amazon_order_id = orders.amazon_order_id
INNER JOIN int_amazon_selling_partner__item ON order_item.asin = int_amazon_selling_partner__item.asin
WHERE orders.order_status = 'Canceled'

query: Could you please show me the researching quantity type name, the quantity in that category, the inventory summary ID, the total researching quantity for that summary, the item name, and the fulfillable quantity from the Amazon Selling Partner FBA inventory data? Group the results by these six fields, add a count of rows in each group, sort by that count from highest to lowest, and give me the top 10 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.name,
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.quantity,
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.inventory_summary_id,
  fba_inventory_summary.total_researching_quantity,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_name,
  fba_inventory_summary.fullfillable_quantity,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM fba_inventory_summary
INNER JOIN int_amazon_selling_partner__item ON fba_inventory_summary.asin = int_amazon_selling_partner__item.asin
INNER JOIN fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry ON fba_inventory_summary._fivetran_id = fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.inventory_summary_id
GROUP BY
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.name,
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.quantity,
  fba_inventory_researching_quantity_entry.inventory_summary_id,
  fba_inventory_summary.total_researching_quantity,
  int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_name,
  fba_inventory_summary.fullfillable_quantity
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 10

query: In the Xero invoice line items data, please show me the contact name, account name, line item description, invoice date, invoice number, and invoice status, along with the total line amount and total quantity for each combination? Only include line items that have a line amount and that have tracking category data. Group the results by contact name, account name, description, date, invoice number, and status.
sql:
SELECT
  contact.name,
  account.name,
  invoice_line_item.description,
  invoice.date,
  invoice.invoice_number,
  invoice.status,
  SUM(CAST(invoice_line_item.line_amount AS REAL)) AS total,
  SUM(CAST(invoice_line_item.quantity AS REAL)) AS total_quantity
FROM invoice_line_item
INNER JOIN invoice ON invoice_line_item.invoice_id = invoice.invoice_id
INNER JOIN account ON invoice_line_item.account_code = account.code
INNER JOIN contact ON invoice.contact_id = contact.contact_id
INNER JOIN int_xero__invoice_line_item_pivoted_tracking_categories ON invoice_line_item.line_item_id = int_xero__invoice_line_item_pivoted_tracking_categories.line_item_id
WHERE invoice_line_item.line_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY contact.name, account.name, invoice_line_item.description, invoice.date, invoice.invoice_number, invoice.status

query: Show me the tracking category status, category name, whether each option is active, whether each option is archived, and the percentage of options that are active within each of those groups from the Xero tracking categories data. Group by category status, category name, whether the option is active, and whether the option is archived so we can see the active percentage for each combination.
sql:
SELECT
  tracking_category.status,
  tracking_category.name,
  tracking_category_option.is_active,
  tracking_category_option.is_archived,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN tracking_category_option.is_active = 't' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM tracking_category_has_option
INNER JOIN tracking_category_option ON tracking_category_has_option.tracking_option_id = tracking_category_option.tracking_option_id
INNER JOIN tracking_category ON tracking_category_has_option.tracking_category_id = tracking_category.tracking_category_id
GROUP BY tracking_category.status, tracking_category.name, tracking_category_option.is_active, tracking_category_option.is_archived

query: Retrieve the product type, date of the latest sync for the product type, image link and variant, average sales rank, and parent ASIN from the Amazon Selling Partner database, grouped by product type, sync date, image link, image variant, and parent ASIN.
sql: SELECT t2.product_type AS product_type, CAST(t2._fivetran_synced AS DATE) AS synced_date_product_type, t3.link AS image_link, t3.variant AS image_variant, AVG(t4.rank) AS avg_sales_rank, t5.parent_asin AS parent_asin FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t2.product_type, t2._fivetran_synced, t3.link, t3.variant, t5.parent_asin

query: Retrieve the ASIN, image link, dimensions, parent ASIN, relationship type, identifier, and identifier type for each item from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t3.asin, t3.link, t3.height, t3.width, t5.parent_asin, t5.type, t8.identifier, t8.identifier_type FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin

query: Retrieve the product type, image link, variant details, parent ASIN, and type from the Amazon Selling Partner database, and find the average sales rank for each combination of these attributes.
sql: SELECT t2.product_type, t3.link, t3.variant, t5.parent_asin, t5.type, AVG(t7.rank) AS avg_sales_rank FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t2.product_type, t3.link, t3.variant, t5.parent_asin, t5.type

query: Retrieve the top 10 ranked items by title, rank, marketplace ID, and item height value for each marketplace from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql:
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT t4.title, t4.rank, t6.marketplace_id, t6.item_height_value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t6.marketplace_id ORDER BY t4.rank) AS rn
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT title, rank, marketplace_id, item_height_value FROM cte WHERE rn <= 10

query: Show the total number of items and the count of unique parent items for each product type in the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT t2.product_type, t5.parent_asin, t6.marketplace_id, t8.identifier_type
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT parent_asin) AS unique_parents
FROM base_data
GROUP BY product_type

query: Retrieve the top five ranked products for each product type, including their titles, ranks, marketplace identifiers, and item identifiers from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql:
WITH ranked_data AS (
    SELECT t2.product_type, t4.title, t4.rank, t6.marketplace_id, t8.identifier,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.product_type ORDER BY t4.rank) AS row_num
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT product_type, title, rank, marketplace_id, identifier FROM ranked_data WHERE row_num <= 5

query: Retrieve the count of items and the count of unique product types from the Amazon Selling Partner database, categorized by rank groupings such as 'Top 100', 'Top 1000', and others based on their sales rank, and show how many items fall into each category.
sql:
WITH categorized_data AS (
    SELECT t2.product_type, t3.variant, t4.title, t7.rank,
           CASE 
               WHEN t7.rank <= 100 THEN 'Top 100'
               WHEN t7.rank <= 1000 THEN 'Top 1000'
               ELSE 'Other'
           END AS rank_category
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT rank_category, COUNT(*) AS item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_type) AS unique_types
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY rank_category

query: Retrieve the number of records and average sales rank for each product type from the Amazon Selling Partner database, specifically for product types with more than three entries.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT t2.product_type, t6.marketplace_id, t7.title, t7.rank
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(rank) AS avg_rank
FROM base_data
GROUP BY product_type
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

query: Retrieve the top 3 ranked variants with their titles and parent ASINs based on their sales rank from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT t3.variant, t4.title, t5.parent_asin, t7.rank,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.parent_asin ORDER BY t7.rank) AS item_rank,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t7.rank) AS overall_rank
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT variant, title, parent_asin, rank, item_rank FROM ranked WHERE item_rank <= 3

query: Retrieve the count of items and their average sales rank, grouped by product type, from the Amazon Selling Partner database, considering default values for missing height and rank data.
sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
    SELECT t2.product_type, t3.variant, t5.parent_asin, t6.marketplace_id, t7.title,
           COALESCE(t3.height, 0) AS height_value,
           COALESCE(t7.rank, 9999) AS rank_value
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin
)
SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS item_count, AVG(rank_value) AS avg_rank
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY product_type

query: Retrieve the count of items, the best rank, and the worst rank for each product type from the Amazon Selling Partner database, considering only items with a rank of 5000 or better.
sql:
WITH raw_data AS (
    SELECT t1.asin, t2.product_type, t4.title, t4.rank
    FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin
    JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT asin, product_type, title, rank FROM raw_data WHERE rank <= 5000
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) AS item_count, MIN(rank) AS best_rank, MAX(rank) AS worst_rank
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY product_type
)
SELECT * FROM aggregated

query: Retrieve the average item height, length, and weight, along with the average sales rank for each product identified by ASIN and marketplace ID, grouped by classification ID, from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t6.asin, t6.marketplace_id, AVG(t6.item_height_value) AS avg_item_height, AVG(t6.item_length_value) AS avg_item_length, AVG(t6.item_weight_value) AS avg_item_weight, t7.classification_id, AVG(t7.rank) AS avg_sales_rank FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t6.asin, t6.marketplace_id, t7.classification_id

query: Retrieve the count of records for items in the Amazon Selling Partner database, grouped by marketplace ID, parent ASIN, variant, title, and identifier type.
sql:
SELECT t3.marketplace_id, t5.parent_asin, t3.variant, t7.title, t8.identifier_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1
JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin
JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin
JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin
JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin
GROUP BY t3.marketplace_id, t5.parent_asin, t3.variant, t7.title, t8.identifier_type

query: Retrieve the identifier, identifier type, item type, and image variant of products from the Amazon Selling Partner database, along with the average item height, total item weight, and count of items, grouped by these attributes.
sql: SELECT t8.identifier, t8.identifier_type, t5.type, t3.variant, AVG(t6.item_height_value) AS average_item_height, SUM(t6.item_weight_value) AS total_item_weight, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t8.identifier, t8.identifier_type, t5.type, t3.variant

query: Retrieve the order ID, status, item title, and quantity ordered for each Amazon order from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t1.amazon_order_id, t1.order_status, t2.title AS item_title, t2.quantity_ordered FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."orders" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."order_item" AS t2 ON t2.amazon_order_id = t1.amazon_order_id

query: Retrieve the item name, brand, manufacturer, product type, and relationship type along with the total number of identifiers for each item from the Amazon Selling Partner database, grouped by item name, brand, manufacturer, product type, and relationship type.
sql: SELECT t1.item_name, t1.brand, t1.manufacturer, t2.product_type, t5.type, SUM(t8.identifier) AS total_identifiers FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t5 ON t5.child_asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_identifier" AS t8 ON t8.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.item_name, t1.brand, t1.manufacturer, t2.product_type, t5.type

query: Retrieve the ASIN, marketplace ID, brand, variant, and image link along with the average sales rank for each item from the Amazon Selling Partner database, grouped by ASIN, marketplace ID, brand, variant, and image link.
sql: SELECT t1.asin, t1.marketplace_id, t1.brand, t3.variant, t3.link, AVG(t7.rank) AS average_rank FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.asin, t1.marketplace_id, t1.brand, t3.variant, t3.link

query: Retrieve the average item weight, weight unit, sales rank title, rank, and image link for each unique combination of brand and item name from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t1.brand, t1.item_name, AVG(t6.item_weight_value) AS avg_item_weight, t6.item_weight_unit, t7.title AS sales_rank_title, t7.rank, t3.link AS image_link FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.brand, t1.item_name, t6.item_weight_unit, t7.title, t7.rank, t3.link

query: Retrieve the ASIN, item name, classification rank, display rank, and relationship type from the Amazon Selling Partner database, and provide the count of records, grouped by ASIN, item name, classification rank, display rank, and relationship type.
sql: SELECT t1.asin, t1.item_name, t5.rank AS classification_rank, t6.rank AS display_rank, t8.type AS relationship_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t5 ON t5.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t8 ON t8.child_asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.asin, t1.item_name, t5.rank, t6.rank, t8.type

query: Retrieve the average height, length, and weight of items, along with their total sales rank and title from the Amazon Selling Partner database, grouped by the item's ASIN.
sql: SELECT t6.asin, AVG(t6.item_height_value) AS average_height, AVG(t6.item_length_value) AS average_length, AVG(t6.item_weight_value) AS average_weight, t7.title, SUM(t7.rank) AS total_rank FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t6.asin, t7.title

query: Retrieve the ASIN, item name, marketplace ID, classification rank, and relationship type from the Amazon Selling Partner database, along with the count of records, grouped by each ASIN, item name, marketplace ID, classification rank, and relationship type.
sql: SELECT t1.asin, t1.item_name, t4.marketplace_id, t5.rank AS classification_rank, t8.type AS relationship_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t5 ON t5.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_relationship" AS t8 ON t8.child_asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.asin, t1.item_name, t4.marketplace_id, t5.rank, t8.type

query: Retrieve the list of products from the Amazon Selling Partner database, including each product's ASIN, total sales rank, item name, product type, and image link, grouped by the ASIN to provide a summary of sales performance.
sql: SELECT t1.asin, SUM(t7.rank) AS total_sales_rank, t1.item_name, t2.product_type, t3.link FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.asin, t1.item_name, t2.product_type, t3.link

query: Retrieve the ASIN, item name, brand, product type, average sales rank, and count of images for each product from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t1.asin, t1.item_name, t1.brand, t2.product_type, AVG(t4.rank) AS avg_rank, COUNT(t3.link) AS image_count FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_product_type" AS t2 ON t2.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_display_group_sales_rank" AS t4 ON t4.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_image" AS t3 ON t3.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t1.asin, t1.item_name, t1.brand, t2.product_type

query: Retrieve the average item weight, total package height, and average sales rank for each marketplace, along with the product titles from the Amazon Selling Partner database.
sql: SELECT t6.marketplace_id, AVG(t6.item_weight_value) AS average_item_weight, SUM(t6.package_height_value) AS total_package_height, t7.title, AVG(t7.rank) AS average_sales_rank FROM "amazon_selling_partner"."item_summary" AS t1 JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_dimension" AS t6 ON t6.asin = t1.asin JOIN "amazon_selling_partner"."item_classification_sales_rank" AS t7 ON t7.asin = t1.asin GROUP BY t6.marketplace_id, t7.title;

query: Retrieve the invoice details including invoice ID, date, account name, region, department, and project from the Xero database, along with the sum of totals for each invoice, grouped by invoice ID, date, account name, region, department, and project.
sql: SELECT t2.invoice_id, t2.date, t4.name, t3.region, t3.department, t3.project, SUM(t2.total) AS total_sum FROM "xero"."invoice_line_item" AS t1 JOIN "xero"."invoice" AS t2 ON t2.invoice_id = t1.invoice_id JOIN "xero"."account" AS t4 ON t4.code = t1.account_code JOIN "xero"."int_xero__invoice_line_item_pivoted_tracking_categories" AS t3 ON t3.line_item_id = t1.line_item_id GROUP BY t2.invoice_id, t2.date, t4.name, t3.region, t3.department, t3.project

query: Retrieve the total line amount for each account code along with the associated region, account name, and contact name from the Xero database, grouped by account code, region, account name, and contact name.
sql: SELECT t1.account_code, SUM(t1.line_amount) AS total_line_amount, t3.region, t4.name AS account_name, t5.name AS contact_name FROM "xero"."invoice_line_item" AS t1 JOIN "xero"."invoice" AS t2 ON t2.invoice_id = t1.invoice_id JOIN "xero"."account" AS t4 ON t4.code = t1.account_code JOIN "xero"."int_xero__invoice_line_item_pivoted_tracking_categories" AS t3 ON t3.line_item_id = t1.line_item_id JOIN "xero"."contact" AS t5 ON t5.contact_id = t2.contact_id GROUP BY t1.account_code, t3.region, t4.name, t5.name

query: Retrieve invoice and line item details along with corresponding contact information, using a join across the invoice line item and invoice tables, and include a column indicating whether the contact is active or deleted.
sql: SELECT t3.invoice_id, t3.line_item_id, t3.source_relation, t3.region, t3.department, t3.location, t3.project, t5.contact_id, t5.name, CASE WHEN t5._fivetran_deleted = TRUE THEN 'Deleted' ELSE 'Active' END AS contact_status FROM xero.int_xero__invoice_line_item_pivoted_tracking_categories t3 JOIN xero.invoice_line_item t1 ON t3.line_item_id = t1.line_item_id JOIN xero.invoice t2 ON t1.invoice_id = t2.invoice_id JOIN xero.contact t5 ON t2.contact_id = t5.contact_id
